description: Use when you know the topic but need authoritative pages. Searches titles, descriptions, headings and body; deduplicates chunks into pages in Fumadocs full-text relevance order (ZBSearch). Rank is a position, not confidence. Read a result with get_page; narrow query or section if has_more is true.

limit.description: Maximum pages to return, from 1 to 20; defaults to 5.

query.description: Keywords to find in documentation titles, descriptions, headings and body; 2 to 500 characters.

section.description: Optional top-level docs section, for example discovery, mcp-servers or retrievability. Unknown sections return no matches.

name: search

has_more.description: More matching pages exist beyond this limit. Narrow query or section, increase limit up to 20, or browse list_pages.

ranking.description: Explanation of the relevance ordering and rank semantics.

results.description: Distinct matching documentation pages, bounded by the caller limit.

id.description: Stable documentation path, independent of rank.

rank.description: 1-based position within this result set, lower is earlier; not confidence and not comparable across queries.

slug.description: Slash-separated docs slug for /api/md; index identifies the docs home.

snippet.description: Matching body or heading excerpt, at most 600 characters.

updated_at.description: Content revision time, or last verification date where a revision time is unavailable.

url.description: Canonical source URL; pass this to get_page.

title: Search documentation
